notes: Version 2.1 updates the status of the former Q5a hypotheses: [H2] of Q5a version 2.0 (strong convergence of the rescaled generators) is proved in H2 for the isometric sinc embedding and discharges no hypothesis of the current Q5a; the weight hypothesis [H-w] is open, W1 establishing no proof of it; the O(q^-2) bound is stated for uniformly bounded weights. The Fourier-structure and truncation results are unchanged.
